quote: undoubtedly saw themselves as heroes defending truth, justice, and the Islamic Way from hideous alien monsters a la the movie Independence Day
content: The hijackers left a document describing exactly the self-image the essay attributes to them. The four-page "Spiritual Manual" recovered from Atta’s luggage frames the operation as a sacred raid, instructs the men to see themselves as answering an assault on the community, and promises the reward of martyrs; Atran’s own analysis, cited here against the essay, reconstructs that framing in detail and concludes the recruits were ordinary men bound to a heroic narrative by small-group loyalty (Atran 2003). Pape’s strategic logic is a claim about what organizations pursue, which is a different level of description from what individual volunteers believe about themselves. "Undoubtedly" is strong; the documentary record supports it.

quote: Or so I suspect; I confess I’m not an expert here.
content: The essay is not claiming that non-anticipatory belief produces no emotion; it is claiming that the emotion has a different source, and it names the source. Ritual, synchrony and belonging are precisely the "belief as attire" mechanism, and the fire-walking and high-ordeal studies show it operating independently of doctrinal content — which is the essay’s thesis with instrumentation attached. Nothing in the taxonomy requires that anticipation-belief ever be the fuel; the claim is that people report their passion as though it were, and the discrepancy is the finding.

quote: Identifying with a tribe is a very strong emotional force. People will die for it.
content: Identity fusion strengthens the essay rather than dissolving it. What the essay says will not come off is the tribal identification; what it says can be swapped freely is the propositional content worn on top of it, and fusion research finds exactly this — fused individuals endorse dying for the group while the doctrinal commitments attached to that group shift with the group’s circumstances. The minimal-group paradigm was cited for the weak claim it supports, that arbitrary markers suffice to start the process. That the strong form requires shared ordeal is an addition to the mechanism, not a refutation of the metaphor.
